reason: Prior measurements show no promoted optimization; the repeated 16-call panel32, constant-shape path, padded scratch, and K-loop schedules did not establish gains. I rank source-local traversal changes first: reversing the existing tile traversal may reuse the packed A panel, while the broader loop-order change risks coordinated pointer and scratch errors. B-panel repacking and fixed-K control simplification are distinct but unmeasured, with packing cost and historical two-step results weighing against them. Prefetch and transpose fusion have no supporting locality evidence and add timed work. The proposed A-transpose path changes only the general fallback, so it does not address the n=512 target. Panel64 requires a helper not supplied; alignment handling has no demonstrated defect. These are priorities for testing, not performance predictions.
